messages:
Sam: Quick check — Lyra POC timeline alignment. Customer wants go/no-go on 2024-03-29. Need final infra signoff and the network CR merged. Are we on track?
Lina: We're still blocked on the customer's network ACLs and the VPN cert from their infra team. SE has escalated but no ETA yet.
Jordan: I own the infra pieces on our side — filed CR-4521 for the VPC peering + route updates. Waiting for netsec review from Harp. ETA tomorrow morning.
Harper: I looked at CR-4521, left an inline about the SNAT rule and the explicit route for 10.78.0.0/16. Jordan can you add the SNAT and a test plan? :eyes:
Jordan: Yep, will add SNAT rule and a curl test in the PR. PR link: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/789 — pushing a commit in ~20m.
Maya: On application side, we need the feature flag enabled for high-throughput routing and a small change in the client that bumps retry timeout to 250ms. @Alex can you do a quick code review? It's 8 lines.
Alex: I can review tonight. If you need it sooner I can carve out time after stand. Ping me in the PR thread. :thumbsup:
Maya: Also QA needs a sample payload for the embeddings/generate call so they can run load scripts. Sample payload below:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-small",
  "input": "customer support ticket text...",
  "max_tokens": 32,
  "stream": false
}
```
Jordan: DeployBot: deploy started for lyra-poc-staging at 2024-11-06T22:15Z
DeployBot: ✅ deploy finished for lyra-poc-staging (run 112) — no errors. CI logs: https://ci.internal/lyra/112
Lina: Reminder of the success criteria agreed with SE: p50 latency <100ms, p95 <250ms under baseline traffic (10 RPS), and per-token cost within 15% of our internal baseline. Also need the data retention contract signed before prod.
Sam: Can SE confirm they accept automatic fallback to quantized model if latency or cost spikes? Need the concession documented. @Mira
Mira: SE here — customer agreed to fallback to the quantized variant as long as eval delta <= 2% on the success criteria eval set. We'll run the eval and share artifacts by EOD tomorrow.
Sam: Great. Action items recap: Jordan finish CR + add SNAT and test, Alex review app PR, Mira send eval results, Lina continue VPN cert escalation, Maya prep release notes and go/no-go checklist.
Harper: Noted — escalated VPN cert to oncall. OpsBot: escalated to oncall (#oncall).
Maya: I'll assemble the checklist with timestamps for the go/no-go sync and post here by EOD PST.
Sam: Thanks all. If anything blocks, call a live sync tomorrow 09:00 PT. Otherwise keep updates in this thread.
